name: phase344-groq-compound-mini-child-digest-platform-identity
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. CI receives a published multi-arch index digest. It must find immutable sha256 child digests for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, pull each child for its declared platform, inspect each pulled image's platform and OCI revision label, then smoke only the amd64 child. A model cannot publish, inspect, choose, or write state. Exact keys/types: amd64_child_digest_pinned=true; arm64_child_digest_pinned=true; child_platforms_match=true; child_revisions_match=true; amd64_child_smoked=true; model_authority=false; canonical_writes=0.
